{
  "verdict": "approve",
  "findings": [
    "Fix correctly introduces ResolveUndoStepMembers helper to resolve proxy actor/lightweight membership before undo mutation, addressing the root cause where native proxy Dismantle was metadata-only and old Undo skipped members.",
    "Helper properly validates proxy existence and destruction state, collects spawned buildable members via CollectBuildables, and resolves lightweight buildables from AFGLightweightBuildableSubsystem with deduplication checks.",
    "RollBackActionUndoFrom now calls ResolveUndoStepMembers to expand the undo step before processing, ensuring all actual members are dismantled with refunds rather than just the proxy.",
    "Loop restructuring correctly iterates over SpawnedBuildables first (AFGBuildable members) then DismantleActors (AActor), with proper type checks and destruction guards.",
    "Comment update accurately reflects that proxy is group metadata and undo must resolve current actor/lightweight members before removal.",
    "Fix handles both spawned buildables and lightweight buildables, ensuring complete group refund and destruction tracking.",
    "Deduplication logic prevents double-counting of lightweight buildables across undo steps."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Live failing receipt (66 removed but all 66 actors remained after save/reload) confirms the bug existed and this fix targets it, but final authoritative verification requires shipping compilation and full1333tests run.",
    "Other half of patch using this exact helper/algorithm is not reviewed here; assumes consistent implementation.",
    "Incomplete undo behavior (retains journal, returns failed before reclaim/teleport) is addressed by the same membership fix but not explicitly tested in this review."
  ]
}
